mapper.select: select b.brand_name ,p.product_name ,p.original_price ,p.price ,p.category_id ,p.discount_rate from product p join brand b on p.brand_id = b.brand_id where p.product_id = #{product_id}
select image_url,sort_order from product_image where product_id = #{product_id} order by sort_order

SELECT og.option_group_id, og.group_name, og.required, ov.option_value_id, ov.option_name FROM option_group og JOIN option_value ov ON og.option_group_id = ov.option_group_id WHERE og.product_id = #{product_id} ORDER BY og.sort_order, ov.sort_order

SELECT CATEGORY_ID, CATEGORY_NAME FROM CATEGORY START WITH CATEGORY_ID = ( SELECT CATEGORY_ID FROM PRODUCT WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{product_id} ) CONNECT BY PRIOR PARENT_ID = CATEGORY_ID ORDER BY LEVEL DESC

SELECT p.product_id, p.brand_id, b.brand_name, p.product_name, p.original_price, p.price, p.category_id, p.discount_rate, pi.image_url AS image_url,
NVL(r.avg_rating, 0) AS avg_rating, NVL(r.review_count, 0) AS review_count, NVL(s.sales_quantity, 0) AS sales_quantity
FROM product p
JOIN brand b ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT product_id, ROUND(AVG(rating), 1) AS avg_rating, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM review GROUP BY product_id ) r ON p.product_id = r.product_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT po.product_id, SUM(od.quantity) AS sales_quantity FROM orders_detail od JOIN product_option po ON po.product_option_id = od.product_option_id GROUP BY po.product_id ) s ON p.product_id = s.product_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT product_id, image_url, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY sort_order ) AS rn FROM product_image ) pi ON p.product_id = pi.product_id AND pi.rn = 1 WHERE p.category_id IN
#{categoryId}
ORDER BY
p.created DESC, p.product_id
p.price ASC, p.product_id
avg_rating DESC, p.product_id
NVL(s.sales_quantity, 0) DESC, p.product_id
avg_rating DESC, p.product_id
